name: 6-Bridges River Cruise
description: See Porto from a different perspective on this classic family-friendly boat tour. A relaxing way to admire the city's iconic bridges and riverside architecture.
longDescription:
The 6-Bridges River Cruise offers a perspective of Porto from the Douro River, passing under the city's six bridges. This classic boat tour provides views of both Porto and Vila Nova de Gaia's riverfronts, showcasing the architectural diversity of the bridges and the historic riverside buildings. The cruise operates daily during its scheduled run.

Visitors can expect a relaxing journey on the Douro, suitable for all ages. The tour typically lasts around 50 minutes, offering ample opportunity to observe the city's landscape from the water. The boats depart from the Ribeira Docks, a central and historic area of Porto known for its riverside activity.

This is a ticketed event, with tickets available for purchase at the Ribeira Docks. The docks are within walking distance of São Bento train station and are served by various bus routes. The area is generally accessible, though some cobblestone surfaces are present. The cruise is designed to accommodate families.
